title: Grade 2 French — Wed, May 20
description: Bonjour! — Day 3 of 5: Animals and body parts
subject: french

questions.question: How do you say 'cat' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Chat' = Cat. 'Le chat' (male) or 'la chatte' (female). Cats say 'miaou' in French!

questions.question: What is 'chien' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Chien' = Dog. Dogs say 'ouaf ouaf' in French (not 'woof woof')!

questions.question: How do you say 'fish' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Poisson' = Fish. Be careful — 'poisson' (fish) and 'poison' (poison) sound different but look similar!

questions.question: What is 'oiseau'?
questions.explanation: 'Oiseau' = Bird. Plural: 'oiseaux'. 'Le petit oiseau' = the little bird.

questions.question: How do you say 'eyes' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Yeux' = Eyes (plural of 'œil'). 'J'ai deux yeux.' = I have two eyes.

questions.question: What is 'nez' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Nez' = Nose. 'J'ai un nez.' = I have a nose. The z is silent in 'nez'.

questions.question: How do you say 'mouth' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Bouche' = Mouth. 'Ouvre la bouche!' = Open your mouth! (the doctor says this)

questions.question: What is 'tête'?
questions.explanation: 'Tête' = Head. 'Tête, épaules, genoux, pieds' = Head, shoulders, knees and toes (a French children's song).

questions.question: How do you say 'hand' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Main' = Hand. 'Donne-moi la main!' = Give me your hand! You use your 'main' to write.

questions.question: What is 'lapin'?
questions.explanation: 'Lapin' = Rabbit. 'Un lapin blanc' = a white rabbit.

questions.question: How do you say 'foot' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Pied' = Foot. Plural: 'pieds'. 'J'ai deux pieds.' = I have two feet.

questions.question: What is 'oreilles'?
questions.explanation: 'Oreilles' = Ears (plural). 'J'ai deux oreilles.' = I have two ears.

questions.question: How do you say 'horse' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Cheval' = Horse. Plural: 'chevaux'. A famous French dish: 'cheval' (horsemeat) — though not common today.

questions.question: What animal says 'meuh meuh' in French?
questions.explanation: A cow (vache) says 'meuh' in French (moo in English). 'La vache fait meuh meuh.'

questions.question: Complete: 'J'ai deux ___ et deux oreilles.' (eyes)
questions.explanation: 'J'ai deux yeux et deux oreilles.' = I have two eyes and two ears. Yeux = eyes (plural).
